messages.text:
Solar's the ideal case — your power cost basically drops out, so every sat stacked is yours and the block shot runs for free. Of the two you were looking at, the Magic Miner 40T at $799 is the best value per TH we sell.

How many watts can your setup spare?

2.48 kW peak — plenty. The 40T pulls ~650 W at 40 TH/s, 850 W in Turbo for 50 TH/s, so it runs full tilt on daylight with room to spare and stays around 50 dB in Eco.

$799, Batch 6 presale, and it's our best value per terahash. Want me to build the cart?
